title: Filed
alt: Four panels. 1: Margo, behind her desk, says the stamp is not here; a faint rust ink mark shows where it usually sits. Pip, holding a mustard folder, asks where it is. 2: Margo throws her arms up, the desk drawer open and papers flying, and says nobody panic. Pip, worried, says that without it nothing is approved and somewhere a bus is not waiting. 3: FWUMP: a note appears in the tube hatch. Margo flinches with arms up and tells Pip not to read it; Pip looks flustered. 4: Close-up. Pip, startled, points out that the stamp is in Margo's hair: its handle sticks out of her grey bun. Margo, deadpan, says it is filed.
hover: The Director's note is still in the tube. It can't be handled until something is stamped.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: The stamp is not here.
Panel 2 – PIP: Without it, nothing is approved. Somewhere, a bus is not waiting.
Panel 3 – MARGO: Do not read it.
Panel 4 – PIP: It's in your hair.
note: I asked Margo where she keeps the stamp. She said 'filed'. I've decided not to ask which cabinet.
